mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the weather is a pleasant 65 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park, with a full moon visible.

The City of Verona has launched a rain barrel rebate program where residents can earn a 30 dollar credit per 35-gallon barrel. Additionally, the Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive intersection will be closed from August 5 to August 7 for construction.
We have a busy day in store with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co all taking place today.
In our weekly update, we noted that on Sunday, July 26, a driver was arrested for an O W I after being stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway.

Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Turtle Cheesecake. Please note the store is currently closed and will open its doors at 10:00 AM. If you are looking ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Turtle Dove.
